column4: Existing source-only counterexample: Anonymous Open Problem Garden comments dated June 29, 2010, https://www.openproblemgarden.org/op/odd_cycles_and_low_oddness#comment-6751 and July 2, 2010, https://www.openproblemgarden.org/op/odd_cycles_and_low_oddness#comment-6753 . No solution DOI or journal publication authenticated, so C is blank; no new publication. Complete original negative reconstructed: for every odd n>=3, the cyclic chain of Petersen-minus-spoke fragments is a connected simple bridgeless cubic graph on 10n vertices, every cycle of every 2-factor is odd, and oddness is exactly n+1. The n=3 case has 30 vertices and oddness 4. Full original target and both actual comment bodies read; exact HTML hash matches the frozen source. Cut parity forces all/no links; local restored Petersen factors then prove a single 5n-cycle in the all-link case, alongside n five-cycles, while the zero-link case has 2n five-cycles. Both states are explicitly realized. Independently verified local Petersen facts and all global factors for n=1 through 7; new normal/-O/-OO checks agree with 11 controls per mode. The original has no 3-edge-connectivity requirement; the examples have 2-edge-cuts. No minimum order, novelty, exhaustive priority, journal peer review, or formal certification claim.
